SUBJECT: Design boundary for INIT/READY dependency failures after removing non-DOC-C error transitions
FACT: Final DOC-C SystemEvent includes timeout, error, recover, fatal, cancel.
Final DOC-C matrix authorizes error->FREEZE only from RUNNING and VERIFYING.
Final DOC-C declares request-OTAC email-provider failure as 503 DEPENDENCY_FAILURE.
Final DOC-C inspected build-spec text does not define INIT/READY dependency failure as an error->FREEZE transition.
Current bootstrap.ts blob d6292374efca4b55bb3865e7151175674ad06b3e catches bootstrap failure and attempts transitionSystemState('error','CORE') whenever current state is neither FREEZE nor STOP.

Current auth-failure.ts blob 92c3f4c7cebc495d9c8badc1cec0b14b4c71dd0c routes persistence failure through buildFreezeEnvelope; freeze.ts blob e2e62e29553b9c62b6de5aef5082c68fe54d478d implements that as transitionSystemState('error','LAW').
ENGINEERING_INFERENCE: A bootstrap dependency failure before successful INIT->READY admission can fail closed by rejecting process/service admission and preserving the current FSM state, rather than inventing an INIT/READY error transition.

A dependency failure while the persisted state is READY should block the affected operation and preserve state unless a DOC-C-authorized event/transition applies. Returning a declared dependency error is separable from changing the global FSM.
Generic freeze helpers should not assume error is legal from every state; they need an explicit state-aware contract or caller-specific path.
UNKNOWN: Final DOC-C inspected evidence does not specify a distinct FSM target such as STOP for startup dependency failure.
Whether non-FSM incident logging is mandatory for a rejected bootstrap attempt is not stated in the inspected DOC-C clauses.
No semantic choice among undeclared transitions may be promoted to FACT without new DOC-C evidence.
FORBIDDEN: Do not preserve INIT/READY + error solely to keep existing tests green.
Do not map startup/auth dependency failure to STOP or another state without authoritative evidence.
Do not direct-mutate NEXY.AI-Test-AI while the worker-ref namespace incident remains open.
RECOMMENDED_REPAIR_SHAPE: Separate operation/admission failure from FSM transition. Make FSM transition calls only when the current state/event pair is declared by DOC-C; fail the operation/service admission otherwise. Then update callers and tests to assert fail-closed behavior without fabricating an undeclared transition.
